title: Zwischenbericht Quellen Into Bibliography
description: Remove the explicit Quellen tables from the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht (P.Q in anhang/projekte.tex and SB.Q in anhang/sekundaerbefunde.tex) and replace them with a proper biblatex bibliography: new references.bib, \cite in each project's Allgemein table and in the SB appendix intro, \SemioReferences rendered in the V Verzeichnisse appendix chapter. Also extend the shared semio-window.sty reference row to show the source URL and fix a suspected \citefield argument-order bug, verified against a rebuilt zukunftbau template.
summary: Removed the explicit Quellen tables (P.Q in anhang/projekte.tex, SB.Q in anhang/sekundaerbefunde.tex) from the mit-bestand Zwischenbericht and replaced them with a proper biblatex bibliography. Created references.bib with 62 @online entries (migrated from the P.Q table's S0xx rows, semantic cite keys, original TeX escaping preserved) plus one @report entry for the BaselCircular/Cirkla study. Wired \addbibresource and \SemioReferences into zwischenbericht.tex (V Verzeichnisse chapter). Added a Quelle column with \cite{...} to each of the 67 project Allgemein tables in projekte.tex (proj:46 cites two sources); cited the BaselCircular study inline in the SB appendix intro. While implementing, fixed two latent bugs in the shared semio-window.sty reference-table renderer (used by all zukunftbau/report/paper templates, not just this document): (1) \citefield{title}{#1} had reversed arguments per the biblatex manual (\citefield{key}[format]{field}) so titles rendered as empty/wrong text — fixed to \citefield{#1}{title}; (2) all reference-table rows shared the same (final) row number because \gappto defers expansion of \thesemio@reference@nr to render time — fixed by freezing each row's number via \arabic{semio@reference@nr} at collection time (exp_args:Nnx into a two-arg append helper). Also extended the reference row to show the entry's URL (footnotesize, under the title) when present, using a box-width test (\citeurl{#1} into an hbox, check \box_wd) rather than any risky edef-time field access — an earlier attempt using expl3 prop storage of \thefield{url} caused a real 'TeX capacity exceeded [input stack]' failure since \thefield isn't edef-expandable outside driver context; reverted to this safer runtime-branch approach. Verified via full tectonic builds: mit-bestand Zwischenbericht (light+dark) and the forschungsbericht zukunftbau template (light+dark, entries without url) both compile cleanly with zero undefined-citation warnings, correct titles, sequential 1..63 reference numbering, and correctly attached per-project citations (spot-checked proj:01 → [29], proj:46 → [2, 8], SB intro → [1]).
